method: Each .docx was opened as a zip and every word/header*.xml and word/footer*.xml part read in document order. A paragraph's text is the concatenation of its w:t runs, with w:tab as a tab, w:br as a newline and w:noBreakHyphen as '-'; a Word field is emitted once as {FIELD <instruction>} and its cached result (the page number Word last rendered) is DISCARDED, because that number is a rendering artifact, not text of the form. Trailing empty paragraphs are dropped. Word splits these strings across many runs ("Version 1." + "2"), so the values below are reconstructions of the rendered string, not any single run. Non-breaking spaces (U+00A0) inside the copyright line are preserved verbatim.
why: pandoc drops headers and footers entirely, so source/md/ carries none of this. The version stamp and the licence line live ONLY here, and the licence line is a condition of the CC BY-ND grant, so anything that reproduces a form has to put it back.
